Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg LTD (TSM) Shareholder Bruni J V & Company Has Lowered Its Stake as Share Value Declined; Berkshire Hathaway Holding in Apple (AAPL) Has Raised by $12.40 Billion as Shares Rose
June 13, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Warren Buffett increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 44.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Hathaway Inc bought 74.23 million shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Warren Buffett held 239.57M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $40.19 billion, up from 165.33 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $944.89B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.02% or $0.04 $192.24. About 7.22M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Bruni J V & Company decreased its stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd (TSM) by 19.82% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bruni J V & Company sold 168,262 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 680,699 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.79 million, down from 848,961 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bruni J V & Company who had been investing in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $200.14 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.70% or $0.27 $39.47. About 3.93 million shares traded. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 10.49% uptrending.
